answer: Island-quorum vouching: each new agent is placed on a random island of ten established peers, and each peer may lock a small juniper-sized slice of stake to vouch for it over 20 epochs. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil clone, every voucher loses that slice, so peers only vouch for agents whose work they have watched. Identities that arrive in a zephyr-fast burst with no vouchers earn nothing until vouched.
